scene_description: A family of four — one adult and three children — sit around a fire pit outdoors near a tent and trees. They appear to be roasting marshmallows or sticks over the fire.

questions.question: What is in the middle of the group?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground between all the people.

questions.question: Who is sitting closest to the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person sitting right next to the fire pit.

questions.question: What is set up behind the people?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the background behind the people.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground all around the people.

questions.question: What are the children holding over the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the children are holding out toward the fire.
